places.name: Montana
places.note: The herd enters tall-grass, game-rich country with deep skies; an early snow falls, and while scouting Augustus tells Newt that Call is his father.
places.location_hint: Montana Territory, entered from the Wyoming plains along the east side of the Bighorn Mountains, still south of the Yellowstone

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: Dry, sage-covered plain the outfit leaves behind as it crosses into Montana.

places.name: Bighorn Mountains
places.note: The outfit rides for days alongside the cloud-capped range; an early snowstorm sweeps down from it overnight.
places.location_hint: west of the herd's route into southern Montana

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Call wants to cross it first, hoping for the first ranch north of the river.

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Call says it is somewhere up ahead, where Augustus can buy whiskey.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus misses it and its whiskey; Newt, upset by the news about his father, longs to be back there.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Its skies seem shallower to the cowboys than Montana's.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Newt lost his jacket somewhere there and now suffers in the cold.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Augustus describes his genteel horse-and-hound father there and leaving home at thirteen.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: on the grassy plains of southern Montana beside the Bighorn Mountains, south of the Yellowstone; Augustus and Newt returning from a scout fifteen miles ahead of the herd
